verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document custom container support (pull from Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR), templates as pre-configured Docker image setups, and CLI/console commands to create Pods with a specified --image, covering both custom Docker images and custom templates. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of custom templates (e.g., TheBloke's templates) though also notes the execution environment is somewhat locked down for certain low-level networking tools. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of pushing a fully custom image end-to-end, and more detail on template creation UI/workflow beyond docs summaries.
